verdict.rationale: Linear's Customer Requests feature collects customer feedback onto issues and projects. Requests come in from integrations such as Intercom, Front and Slack Asks, and can be viewed, filtered, searched by customer and analyzed in bulk, which covers the core of a central feedback repository. The evidence centers on customers and only shows searching the customer list, so internal colleague requests and full-text search across all feedback are not clearly documented. Missing for 10: explicit intake of internal colleague requests, full-text search across all request content, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can access one searchable repository for all product requests and feedback from colleagues and customers

citations.quote: Understand customer use-cases directly on the issues and projects they’ve asked for, or analyze feedback in bulk with Linear Agent
View and filter issues or projects by customer name, count, status, tier revenue, and size to identify high impact customer work
Open the full customer list with G then Q, then search to narrow down results
Automatically turn conversations and customer feedback into actionable issues that are instantly routed, labeled, and prioritized for the right team.
